text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Nobody knows...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The true self beneath the surface that 
nobody knows.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Deep down, she's a timid, crybaby, sulking 
girl. But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ever since the day I put on the mask given 
to me by my masked wrestler dad—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bueno! The world's strongest Umamusume, El 
Condor Pasa, is heeeere-desu!!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: No, even though everyone knows, really...

Today marks the beginning of our challenge 
for the Twinkle Series with my trainee 
Umamusume.

"Yet she's nowhere to be seen at the 
meeting spot. Where on earth could she 
be?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha!! Trainer-san, where are you 
looking, yes!? Over heeere, yeees!

"There's a voice coming from up in the 
tree?! That's—"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Toh!! Explosive talent! Pro-wrestling 
spirit! And, I loooove spicy food!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for the top of the world, soaring 
beyond the Twinkle stars, it's your 
assigned Umamusume, El Condor Pasaaa!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, good morning desu, Trainer! Are you 
feeling in tip-top shape!?
choice_data_list: Aren't you pushing yourself too hard, El?
Aren't you overdoing it yourself, El?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I-I haven't, deee-su! If I overdo it, 
Trainer will scold me.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
“Still, if you tell me to charge forward, 
there's no stopping me no matter how far 
we go!”

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The world's El Número Uno! My ambition to 
become No. 1 is bigger than the Andes, 
dess!

El Condor Pasa. Her talent is undisputedly 
at a level capable of aiming for world's 
strongest.

“However, neither her mind nor body has 
fully matured. A chick cannot soar the 
highest in the world as she is.”

While making the most of her strengths—her 
super motivation and super positivity— I 
must nurture her well.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's true that until now, whenever I took 
off alone, I often hit the ceiling and 
came crashing down, YES.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, now that I have you by my side, 
Trainer, there's nothing for me to fear!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ¿Qué? A rival...?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it is true that El has a lot of strong 
Umamusume in her generation...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"First up, El's roommate! A prodigy hiding 
a deep blue flame beneath her refined 
grace—Grass Wonder!"

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Hello there~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Nube! Drifting like a floating cloud! Yet 
the lazy assassin who delivers when it 
counts, Seiun Sky!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: ...Not that I'm gonna do it, though~.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Always sporting an attitude bigger than 
El! Brawling outside the ring under the 
banner of first-class, our beloved King— 
King Halo!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'm so loved it's almost scary!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And my beloved Spe-chan!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: That's all for me?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"Howeeever, they are not the ones who 
shall take flight on the world stage!! Who 
will it be? Just who could it be, you 
ask?!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"*Ahem*! Trainer-san, I'm going to ask you 
the same thing I asked when we teamed up, 
okay?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Sprinting across the turf as if flying, 
the world's strongest Umamusume!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And that name is?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"That is correct! Now is the time to take 
our first step toward the world and soar 
into the Twinkle Series!"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The timid El is no more! To become the 
world's strongest, we'll form the ultimate 
tag team and fly high!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Let's soar! Higher than that condor! 
Higher! Even higher! Wheeeeeee!

El Condor Pasa shouts at the top of her 
lungs toward the open sky.

text_block_list.name: Pigeon
text_block_list.text: Popopopopopopo...

"Overhead was a condor! ...No, wait, it 
was just a pigeon fluttering by."
